speaker: Nora
text: This is it... the Cavern of Echoes. The air hums with ancient energy.

speaker: Kyle
text: So this is where the Blade Edge sleeps. Let’s hope the legends were right.

speaker: Nora
text: Be cautious. The sword may grant power, but it also demands something in return.

speaker: Kyle
text: I’ve already lost everything. Let it take what’s left.
